items.question: For what purpose is the kula-agama or kula-duty mentioned?
items.inference: The verse presents either kula-agama or kula-duty as the sole purpose.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic role of artham remains unclear.
Whether eva modifies the second alternative only is ambiguous.
items.plain_english: For the kula-agama, or for kula-duty only, or.
